reviewCharts.warning: Kansas review rows use official Kansas Secretary of State precinct presidential rows and President-versus-U.S.-House same-row comparisons. The U.S. House workbook stores Johnson, Sedgwick, Shawnee, and Wyandotte in separate wide-format tabs; three nonzero presidential local rows do not have a matching House comparison and are kept as vote-share-only rows. U.S. House is district-based, so these are advisory screening inputs, not confirmed findings.
